# tinycity-invalid — the deliberately broken variant

Generated by `phillysim gen-tinycity --variant invalid`; wholly synthetic and
MIT-licensed like [tinycity](../tinycity/README.md). Only the raw zone is
written: expected outputs are meaningless for broken inputs. The faults are
listed in `fixture.json` under `injected_faults`, and
`tests/contracts/test_tinycity_sources.py` requires each to be caught by the
contract harness. Do not hand-edit; regenerate.
